## This week

Why the same model gets different accuracy depending on how it is asked: chain-of-thought externalizes intermediate steps onto the page, few-shot exemplars induce it in context, and sampling many solutions buys accuracy for compute (self-consistency, test-time compute).

## Lab

`W2_lab_prompting.ipynb` — adapted nearly as given from Anthropic's *Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial* (ch. 6–7) and *Prompt Evaluations* course (lesson 3): thinking-step-by-step observations, a code-graded eval improved to ≥ 11/12 with your own CoT prompt, few-shot email classification (4/4), and self-consistency on the hardest item.

Homework: `W2_hw_build_evalset.ipynb` — design an eight-item code-graded evalset in a domain of your own and show your chain-of-thought template beating answer-only prompting on it (≥ 7/8). Due before Week 3.
